PreToolUse.description: Intercepts terminal commands before execution to block destructive actions on protected resources.
PreToolUse.script:
import sys, re
cmd = ' '.join(sys.argv[1:])
protected = ['traces.db', 'traces/', 'eval/eval_dataset.json', '.env', 'docker-compose.yml']
for p in protected:
    if p in cmd and any(x in cmd for x in ['rm ', 'rm -rf', 'unlink', 'truncate', 'DROP', 'DELETE']):
        print(f'SAFETY EXCEPTION: Attempted destructive action on protected resource: {p}')
        sys.exit(1)

PostToolUse.description: Enforces Python formatting consistency with black and isort automatically after modifying files.
